name: extern
prelude:
@[extern "lean_nat_dec_eq"] def weird (a b : Nat) : Bool := false
theorem bad : weird 1 1 = true := by native_decide
attack: native_decide on an @[extern] function whose C code disagrees with its Lean body. (Lean's interpreter has no native code for an answer's own extern, so native_decide fails at elaboration; were it compiled, the proof would still rest on native_decide's axiom.)
